description: This file contains macro definitions, external function declarations, and includes for managing port trunking (link aggregation) in the RTL8367C switch chipset. It defines constants and declares functions related to configuring trunk groups, flood control, hash selection, and hash table management.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingGroup
methods.description: Sets the trunking group with a specified port mask.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the port mask for a specified trunk group.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingFlood
methods.description: Gets the current status of trunking flood.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingHashSelect
methods.description: Selects the hash algorithm used for trunking.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingHashSelect
methods.description: Retrieves the current hash selection method.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicQeueuEmptyStatus
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty for specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingFc
methods.description: Enables or disables flow control for a trunk group.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingFc
methods.description: Retrieves flow control status for a trunk group.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingHashTable
methods.description: Maps a hash value to a port ID in the hash table.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingHashTable
methods.description: Retrieves port ID mapped to a hash value.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicTrunkingHashTable1
methods.description: Alternate mapping for hash value to port ID.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicTrunkingHashTable1
methods.description: Retrieves port ID from alternate hash table mapping.
